title: Particle lab
slow: This computer cannot keep up: the simulation runs at {x}× real time.
slowLowest: This is already the lowest level. Time runs slower, but the results stay the same.
m1Note: Stage M1a: mechanics — liquid and gas, walls, surface tension, buoyancy. Heat and boiling come next.
airNote: Air far from everything is computed without particles: still, at room temperature (the background of the box). Air particles exist only near liquids and apparatus.
fullPowerTitle: Open the lab in a new tab — it computes on every processor core
fullPowerSlow: In a new tab the lab computes on every core:
hintPaint: Drag across the box to paint with the chosen material.
hintErase: Drag to erase — air comes back into the empty space.
hintPlace: Click where the chosen apparatus should stand (its bottom at the click).
hintWall: Drag from the start to the end of the wall.
hintInspect: Click a particle to see its data.
noWebgl2: This browser does not support WebGL2 — the lab computes but does not draw.

ai.format:
Particle lab scene (module “Particle lab”) — JSON. The engine computes everything from local rules and the substance database; the scene only says what stands where at the start (it is the starting setup, not the course of events).
Units: metres (origin in the lower left corner of the inside of the box, y upwards), temperatures in °C, pressure in kPa, power in W (per layer thickness).

{ "format": "recreatio/particles", "version": 1, "seed": number (repeatable randomness),
  "box": { "w": width, "h": height, "depth": thickness of the 2D layer (usually 0.01) },
  "ambient": { "p": kPa (101.325), "T": °C, "g": m/s² (0 — weightlessness), "air": { "N2": 0.7676, "O2": 0.2324 } },
  "sides": { "left" | "right" | "bottom" | "top": "wall" or "open" (an open side is the room) },
  "quality": "very-high" | "high" | "medium" (particle size 2 / 2.5 / 3 mm; usually "very-high"),
  "ops": [ build steps in order ] }

Steps ("op"):
  { "op": "fill", "region": region, "composition": { substance: mass fraction }, "phase": "liquid" | "gas", "T": °C } — fills the region with liquid or gas (whatever was there gives way)
  { "op": "erase", "region": region } — removes everything in the region; air comes back
  { "op": "solid", "region": region, "material": material, "T": °C } — a fixed solid (a wall, boiling chips)
  { "op": "beaker", "x": centre, "y": bottom, "w": width, "h": height, "wall": wall thickness, "material": "glass" } — a beaker (cross-section)
  { "op": "hotplate", "x": centre, "y": bottom, "w", "h", "material": "steel", "mode": "power" | "thermostat", "power": W, "target": °C, "on": true } — a hot plate
Region: { "rect": [x0, y0, x1, y1] } | { "circle": [x, y, r] } | { "poly": [[x, y], …] } | { "line": [x0, y0, x1, y1], "width": thickness }
ai.prompt:
Prepare a JSON starting setup for the “Particle lab” module in REcreatio (a 2D school sandbox made of particles).
Topic: [describe what should stand in the box, e.g. “a beaker of water on a hot plate and boiling chips on the bottom”].
Rules: real sizes (beaker 7 cm wide, plate 16 cm), things do not overlap, apparatus stands on the bottom (y = 0) or on another thing. Return ONE JSON object, without comments.

The beaker holds water at room temperature, with a hot plate under it.
Inspect the particles with the “Inspect” tool — each has its own composition, temperature and mass.
